nodes.label: Flows, Gaps and Audit Trail
nodes.summary: Procedural flows for key equity and trust actions, gap nodes for further research and verification, and cross-links to related domains.

nodes.label: Express Trust Creation: Start
nodes.summary: Identify potential trust. Check three certainties: intention (imperative words), subject matter (segregation for tangibles), objects (complete list or conceptual certainty).

nodes.label: Express Trust Creation: Formalities and Constitution
nodes.summary: Compliance with formalities (Cap 219 s.5 for land trusts). Constitute the trust by vesting legal title in the trustee. Check for sham or illusory elements.

nodes.label: Express Trust Creation: Valid Trust Constituted
nodes.summary: If declaration and transfer valid: trust is properly constituted. If not: consider resulting trust or equity will not assist a volunteer. For testamentary: check secret trust requirements.

nodes.label: Resulting Trust: Start
nodes.summary: Identify voluntary transfer or purchase-money contribution. Raise presumption of resulting trust. Check relationship for presumption of advancement.

nodes.label: Resulting Trust: Check Rebuttal and Purpose
nodes.summary: Consider rebutting evidence of actual intention. If purpose-specific loan: Quistclose trust arises on purpose failure. If engrafted gift fails: apply Hancock v Watson (original gift takes effect).

nodes.label: Resulting Trust: Outcome
nodes.summary: If presumption not rebutted: resulting trust. If presumption of advancement applies: gift. If Quistclose purpose fails: secondary resulting trust. If Hancock v Watson: original gift stands.

nodes.label: Constructive Trust: Start
nodes.summary: Identify the category: CICT (family home/property), bribe/secret commission (fiduciary breach), or third-party accessory (knowing receipt or dishonest assistance).

nodes.label: Constructive Trust: Analyse and Quantify
nodes.summary: CICT: prove common intention + detrimental reliance. Quantify shares by whole course of dealings. Bribes: prove fiduciary relationship + bribe/secret commission received. Accessory: prove knowledge + receipt/assistance.

nodes.label: Tracing: Start
nodes.summary: Identify traceable trust property. Establish fiduciary relationship at the start of tracing. Determine the substitute asset or mixed fund.

nodes.label: Tracing: Apply Rules and Determine Interest
nodes.summary: Apply mixed fund rules: trustee presumed spend own money first (Hallett). Innocent volunteers share rateably (Diplock). Lowest intermediate balance rule. Determine proportionate share or charge over asset.

nodes.label: Verify All Case Seeds with HKLII Paragraph Anchors
nodes.summary: Verify every case seed with exact HKLII paragraph anchors and links. Prioritise HK CFA/CA citations.

nodes.label: Add HK CFA/CA Cases on Quistclose, Hastings-Bass and Mistake
nodes.summary: Research and add HK appellate decisions on Quistclose trusts, Hastings-Bass rule, and equitable mistake.

nodes.label: Expand Trustee Ordinance Provisions
nodes.summary: Expand on specific Cap 29 provisions: s.41W duty of care, s.4 investment, s.27 advancement, s.32 power of delegation. Confirm current section numbering.

nodes.label: Add Protective Trusts and Powers vs Trusts
nodes.summary: Research and add cases on protective trusts, the distinction between powers and trusts, and the rule against excessive delegation.

nodes.label: Add Secret Trust Communication and Acceptance Cases
nodes.summary: Research and add HK cases on secret trusts, communication and acceptance requirements, and the timing rules for fully vs half-secret trusts.

nodes.label: Add Equitable Defences and Limitation Cases
nodes.summary: Research HK cases on laches, acquiescence, change of position, and limitation by analogy in equity. Cross-link to land law and family law.

nodes.label: Update with Recent CFA Decisions
nodes.summary: Search for and add recent CFA decisions on dishonest assistance, CICT, and equitable remedies since 2020.

nodes.label: Distinguish Binding HK vs Persuasive UK Authorities
nodes.summary: Tag each case seed as binding on HK courts (CFA, CA decisions post-1997, PC on HK appeal) vs persuasive (English HL/UKSC, Privy Council on non-HK appeal).
